answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the terrace queue while genuine members promoted earlier goes on earning. The pearl index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1311 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the yarrow. The fee repeats 20 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
